remarks: Welcome to 49 Buena Vista Street, a beautifully maintained 1927 Colonial blending timeless charm with modern updates. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath home features a new roof (2024), central air and air exchange systems (2025), and a long list of additional improvements.  The main level offers a sun-filled living room with marble gas fireplace and built-ins, a formal dining room with french doors to the deck, a bright sunroom/office with full bath, and a fully equipped kitchen with gas stove, granite counters, newer appliances, and mudroom access.  Upstairs includes three bedrooms, two with walk-in closets, including a lofted bedroom with skylights offering flexible living space.  A finished basement provides bonus room for recreation and storage. Outdoors, enjoy a private oasis, landscaped yard with deck and patio to relax and enjoy stunning sunsets. Detached garage with new door, updated flooring, and attic storage.  Conveniently located near the Springdale Train Station, restaurants, library & school offering easy access and everyday convenience. Seller asking for best and final offers by 5 PM Monday 4/20
